title: Counit normalization of the residue tensor-pull presentation
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-integral-residue-tensor-pull-presentation] and [new-integral-residue-tensor-model]. Fix a prime ℓ, a normed field E over ℚ_ℓ, a scheme morphism f:X→Y, and any integral homotopy complex P on Y. Write F for integral pullback, B and B' for the restricted regular residue modules on Y and X, H for reduction then restriction on X, and εX for tensorPresentationDerivedCounit on X. Let e:F(B)≅B' be ordinary restriction/pullback on the regular residue module followed by restriction of the inverse monoidal unit of residue pullback, and let eH:Fh(B[0])≅B'[0] be its canonical homotopy image. Put a=F.leftDerivedFunctorCounit(P). Then residueExchangeTensorPullIso at LF(Qh P), followed by residueExchangeTensorModelTarget at P, is H(a) followed by εX(Fh P), then Qh of homotopyTensorSingleIso(B') inverse followed by eH inverse tensor identity on Fh P. This statement contains only the X tensor presentation and its coefficient normalization, no scalar-extension pull mate, and no flatness hypothesis.

proof.text: Normalize the coefficient pull isomorphism c by the exact-F derived counit: c inverse followed by LF(jB) and gamma_F(B[0]) is jB' followed by Qh(eH inverse). Use the singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedFunctorIso definition, exact-F counit factorization and quotientCompQhIso naturality.

Normalize derivedTensorPresentationIso by leftDerivedNatTrans_app, first for derivedTensorSingleIso and then for leftDerivedUnique. Its presentation followed by inverse braiding, jB' tensor identity and the lax Qh comparison equals the defining tensor-presentation counit followed by the inverse ordinary single/tensor comparison.

Expand tensorPullIso and tensorModelTarget, use braiding naturality and the preceding coefficient identity, move a by tensor exchange and presentation naturality, then apply presentation normalization at Fh(P). Qh.map_comp gives the claimed composite. No map is inverted using flatness.

theorem integralResidue_tensorPullCounit_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) Y)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let F := (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧
    let B := residueExchangeOrdinaryCoefficient ℓ E Y
    let B' := residueExchangeOrdinaryCoefficient ℓ E X
    let A := Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (integralResidue ℓ E)
    let SX := Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X)
    letI := residueOrdinaryUpperStarMonoidal A f
    let e : F.obj B ≅ B' :=
      (comapUpperStarIso (integralReductionMap ℓ E) f).symm.app
        (Mod.regular (condensedRingObj A Y)) ≪≫
          SX.mapIso (Functor.Monoidal.εIso (f)^*⟦A⟧).symm
    let eH : (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj (Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B) ≅
      Functor.tensorModelCoefficient B' := (F.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).app
        ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj B) ≪≫
      (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).mapIso
        ((F.mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).app B ≪≫
          (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).mapIso e)
    let φX := coefficientMap (integralReductionMap ℓ E) X
    let H := residueExchangeReduction ℓ E X ⋙ residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E X
    let εX : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ H ⟶
        (tensorLeft B').mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh := by
      unfold H B' residueExchangeOrdinaryCoefficient
        residueExchangeReduction integralReduction residueExchangeRestriction
      exact Mod.tensorPresentationDerivedCounit φX
    let M := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P
    let a : (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M ⟶
        DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) := by
      unfold residueExchangeUpperStar
      exact F.leftDerivedFunctorCounit.app P
    (residueExchangeTensorPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
        ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M) ≫
      residueExchangeTensorModelTarget ℓ E f P =
      H.map a ≫
      εX.app
        ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        ((homotopyTensorSingleIso B').inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
          eH.inv ▷ (F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj P)
